audio_observation: Speaker clearly says a complete sentence.
spoken_content: Tôi sẽ gửi báo cáo vào chiều nay.
expected_transcription: Tôi sẽ gửi báo cáo vào chiều nay.
rule_applied: Transcribe all understandable spoken words.

audio_observation: Speaker uses informal spoken grammar.
spoken_content: Tôi nghĩ là mình đi trước.
expected_transcription: Tôi nghĩ là mình đi trước.
rule_applied: Preserve spoken structure rather than polishing grammar.

audio_observation: Speaker says a number in words.
spoken_content: Tôi có bốn mươi hai khách.
rule_applied: Normalize numerical expressions.
common_error: Leaving the number fully spelled out

audio_observation: Speaker says a decimal quantity.
spoken_content: Khoảng hai phẩy năm triệu.
rule_applied: Normalize numerical expressions into written form.

audio_observation: Speaker says a date using spoken words.
spoken_content: Ngày một tháng một năm hai không hai lăm.
rule_applied: Normalize dates.

audio_observation: Speaker states a time in words.
spoken_content: Ba giờ chiều.
rule_applied: Normalize spoken time.

audio_observation: Speaker states an amount in words.
spoken_content: Năm trăm đô-la.
rule_applied: Normalize monetary amounts.

audio_observation: Speaker states a percentage in words.
spoken_content: Giảm hai mươi lăm phần trăm.
rule_applied: Normalize percentages.

audio_observation: Speaker states a measurement.
spoken_content: Năm mươi dặm một giờ.
rule_applied: Normalize measurements.

audio_observation: Speaker spells a company name using spoken words.
spoken_content: Tôi làm việc tại AT và T.
rule_applied: Restore written special-symbol form.

audio_observation: Speaker noticeably elongates a word.
spoken_content: Thậtttt tuyệt vời.
rule_applied: Write elongated words using normal spelling.

audio_observation: A word is audible but the annotator is not fully certain.
spoken_content: Bạn gặp vấn đề với cân bằng.
expected_transcription: Bạn gặp vấn đề với ((cân bằng)).
rule_applied: Use double parentheses for an educated but uncertain guess.
common_error: Presenting an uncertain word as certain

audio_observation: A short section is muffled and cannot be determined.
spoken_content: Bạn cần gửi một phần trước chiều mai.
expected_transcription: Bạn cần gửi <inaudible> trước chiều mai.
rule_applied: Use <inaudible> when content cannot be determined.

audio_observation: Speaker clearly inserts a foreign-language word.
spoken_content: Tôi cần hoàn thành việc này trước mañana.
expected_transcription: Tôi cần hoàn thành việc này trước {mañana}.
rule_applied: Use curly brackets for foreign-language content.
common_error: Treating foreign content as ordinary Vietnamese

audio_observation: A short foreign-language segment cannot be identified confidently.
spoken_content: Tôi cần hoàn thành việc này trước một từ không rõ.
expected_transcription: Tôi cần hoàn thành việc này trước <inaudible>.
rule_applied: Use <inaudible> when the foreign content cannot be confidently determined.

audio_observation: Speaker spells a name letter by letter.
spoken_content: Tên tôi là Tirelly, đánh vần là T I R E L L Y.
expected_transcription: Tên tôi là Tirelly, đánh vần là T I R E L L Y.
rule_applied: Use uppercase letters separated by spaces.
common_error: Writing letters as a normal word

audio_observation: Two voices alternate clearly.
spoken_content: Speaker 1 says Được rồi. Speaker 2 says Đồng ý.
rule_applied: Use consistent speaker labels.

audio_observation: A quieter second speaker is still understandable.
spoken_content: Speaker 1 asks a question. Speaker 2 answers quietly.
expected_transcription: (Speaker 1) Bạn có đồng ý không? (Speaker 2) Có.
rule_applied: Transcribe understandable speech regardless of perceived background position.

audio_observation: Two speakers overlap briefly and one short phrase cannot be determined.
spoken_content: Primary speech is understandable except for one short overlapping section.
expected_transcription: (Speaker 1) Tôi nghĩ chúng ta nên <inaudible> rồi tiếp tục.
rule_applied: Use <inaudible> for a limited unintelligible overlap.

audio_observation: Two speakers overlap across a critical section and the primary speaker cannot be understood.
spoken_content: Primary speech cannot be reliably determined.
rule_applied: Reject when overlap prevents understanding.
common_error: Trying to invent the overlapping speech

audio_observation: Speaker ends with falling intonation.
spoken_content: Tôi nghĩ vậy.
rule_applied: Use a period for a declarative ending.

audio_observation: Speaker uses rising intonation indicating a question.
spoken_content: Bạn khỏe chứ.
rule_applied: Use punctuation that reflects spoken intonation.
common_error: Using a period because of written grammar

audio_observation: Speaker pauses for more than one second outside normal punctuation.
spoken_content: Tôi đang nghĩ rằng chúng ta nên rồi tiếp tục.
expected_transcription: Tôi đang nghĩ rằng chúng ta nên <pause> rồi tiếp tục.
rule_applied: Use <pause> for a meaningful pause over one second.

audio_observation: Speaker has a normal sentence boundary but no meaningful extra pause.
spoken_content: Tôi nghĩ vậy. Được rồi.
rule_applied: Do not insert <pause> for ordinary punctuation.

audio_observation: Speaker says a supported filler before continuing.
spoken_content: Ừm tôi nghĩ chúng ta nên đi.
expected_transcription: [ừm] tôi nghĩ chúng ta nên đi.
rule_applied: Supported filler uses square brackets.

audio_observation: Speaker produces the filler represented by the approved spelling [yeah].
spoken_content: Yeah, chính xác.
rule_applied: Use the exact approved filler spelling.

audio_observation: Speaker produces a filler not covered by the approved list.
spoken_content: An unsupported filler sound occurs.
expected_transcription: Record the event for project-lead review rather than inventing a new standardized spelling.
rule_applied: Only approved filler vocabulary may be standardized.

audio_observation: Speaker uses a common variant that the guideline standardizes.
spoken_content: Okay.
rule_applied: Apply the approved common-word spelling.

audio_observation: Speaker says the colloquial form represented by the approved common-word rule.
spoken_content: Làm chi vậy?
rule_applied: Apply the approved standard spelling for the listed common word.

audio_observation: Speaker laughs audibly.
spoken_content: Speaker laughs before continuing.
rule_applied: Use <laugh> for laughter.

audio_observation: Speaker laughs while understandable words are spoken.
spoken_content: Chuyện đó thật buồn cười!
rule_applied: Transcribe understandable speech while marking laughter.

audio_observation: Speaker coughs during speech.
spoken_content: Tôi muốn nói rằng chúng ta nên đi.
expected_transcription: Tôi muốn nói <cough> rằng chúng ta nên đi.
rule_applied: Use <cough> for an audible cough.

audio_observation: Speaker makes an audible gasp before continuing.
spoken_content: Speaker gasps before speaking.
expected_transcription: <gasp> Tôi rất nóng lòng muốn thử!
rule_applied: Use <gasp> for the non-verbal event.
common_error: Writing the gasp as a spoken word

audio_observation: Speaker clears their throat before speaking.
spoken_content: Speaker clears throat then speaks.
rule_applied: Use <throatclear> for throat clearing.

audio_observation: A swallow is clearly audible.
spoken_content: Speaker swallows before continuing.
rule_applied: Use <swallow> for the audible swallowing event.

audio_observation: A phone notification is audible but speech remains clear.
spoken_content: Cậu cứ gửi tài liệu cho tôi.
expected_transcription: Cậu cứ gửi tài liệu cho tôi. <noise>
rule_applied: Use <noise> when meaningful environmental noise is audible without blocking comprehension.

audio_observation: Speaker produces incomplete word fragments.
spoken_content: Cậu ta tên là P Ph Phương.
rule_applied: Use a trailing hyphen for incomplete word fragments.

audio_observation: Speaker repeats a complete word three times.
spoken_content: Nhớ mang theo ô ô ô.
expected_transcription: Nhớ mang theo ô ô ô!
rule_applied: Repeat complete words without fragment hyphens.

audio_observation: Recording ends abruptly during an unfinished thought.
spoken_content: Tôi rất mong được tham dự
expected_transcription: Tôi rất mong được tham dự—
rule_applied: Use an em dash for abrupt cut-off.

audio_observation: Speaker clearly uses a regional expression.
spoken_content: Hổng dám đâu.
rule_applied: Preserve dialectal speech as heard.
common_error: Correcting it to Không dám đâu

audio_observation: Speaker uses understandable profanity.
spoken_content: The speaker uses profanity clearly.
rule_applied: Censoring the profanity

audio_observation: Persistent static overlaps the speech and makes the primary speaker unintelligible.
spoken_content: Primary speech cannot be understood.
rule_applied: Reject when noise prevents comprehension.

audio_observation: Crowd noise is audible but the speaker remains understandable.
spoken_content: Cậu cứ nói tiếp đi.
rule_applied: Do not reject understandable speech with background noise.

audio_observation: Music overlaps the speaker continuously and prevents comprehension.
spoken_content: Primary speech cannot be understood because of simultaneous background noise.
rule_applied: Reject when simultaneous noise prevents comprehension.
common_error: Using <noise> despite complete loss of speech

audio_observation: A continuous laughter section occurs before speech resumes.
spoken_content: Speaker laughs continuously for an extended section.
rule_applied: Represent a continuous non-verbal section with one appropriate tag.

audio_observation: Annotator is tempted to use a semicolon to join clauses.
spoken_content: Speaker says two clauses naturally.
expected_transcription: Tôi nghĩ vậy, chúng ta nên đi.
rule_applied: Use only supported punctuation.

audio_observation: Speaker uses a regional word that is intentionally part of the spoken form.
spoken_content: Mở cái đó làm chi?
rule_applied: Preserve dialectal wording even when standard Vietnamese would differ.

audio_observation: Several large sections are repeatedly impossible to understand.
spoken_content: Multiple portions are muffled and cannot be determined.
expected_transcription: Use <inaudible> only where necessary and flag the audio for review if the issue is widespread.
rule_applied: Using <inaudible> for most of the recording
